artworks.title: Nemi
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, gnarled tree in the center. Branches extend across the top of the frame. The scene includes distant hills and a village with a tower on a rocky outcrop. Close to the viewer, detailed brushstrokes create boulders, foliage, and two figures. The color palette is primarily gray and sepia. The style features fine lines and meticulous detail, resembling a traditional engraving.

artworks.title: Head of Dr. Robert Binswanger (the Student)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image features a black and white abstract print of a person's face and part of the head. The face is centered, facing forward, with angular, textured features. The hair is stylized with curved lines. The background shows abstract patterns and shapes, including a leaf or feather-like form. Handwritten words are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Northern Landscape Fantasy Evoking Tivoli
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image, revealing distant hills and a faintly sketched structure. The drawing is made with fine pencil strokes capturing the details of trees, figures, and other elements. The color palette consists of soft sepia tones. In the foreground, there is a gathering of people and animals. Large trees create depth, while faint architectural and natural elements appear in the background. Birds fly in the sky, adding to the scene's tranquility and motion.

artworks.title: Herodias and Salome
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in ochre, brown, and black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is facing mostly forward with a slight inclination toward the viewer's right, eyes closed, featuring smooth facial features, with long hair flowing over the shoulders, and partly covered by a veil. They hold a platter with a detailed, sculpted head on it. The individual on the right faces forward and slightly towards the left, with wide, expressive eyes looking directly at the viewer. Their hair is styled up with a flower-like accessory placed an inch above the forehead, wearing a garment with flowing sleeves. The background appears simple, with no distinct features, enhancing the focus on the individuals in the foreground.

artworks.title: Herodias and Salome
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in two shades of green and black on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a stylized and illustrative manner. Both are shown from the waist up. The woman on the left is holding a platter with a bearded man's severed head. She has closed eyes and a contemplative expression, with her hair partially covered by a cloth. The woman on the right stands facing forward, with wavy hair and a decorative cap. She wears a loose, flowing garment with puffy sleeves. An ornate border surrounds them, featuring a banner in the top left corner and a faded coat of arms in the top right. The background is a plain, muted yellow.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Friedrich Brentel after Aegidius Sadeler II after Christoph Schwarz
artworks.medium: gouache heightened with gold on vellum
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a crucifixion scene. The central focus is a crucifix with a figure and two other crucified figures on either side. The sky above is dark with swirling clouds and beams of light. Various figures in colorful garments are gathered below, with some appearing mournful or shocked. Animals, potentially dogs, are depicted in the foreground, while some figures gesture towards the crucified individuals. The landscape includes sparse trees and an expansive sky. The style resembles that of a Renaissance painter known for dramatic biblical scenes.

artworks.title: Family Promenade in the Park
artworks.medium: gouache with pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips Fund in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image features a group of figures in an elegant and whimsical setting. Most individuals are shown in full length across the scene. At the center, a woman and man are prominently displayed. The woman wears a white gown with puffy sleeves and a tall bonnet, while the man is dressed in a blue and gold outfit with knee-length pants. The woman has pale features, delicate facial characteristics, and styled hair under her bonnet. The man also has pale features, with hair that appears white or powdered in an 18th-century style. Around them, various individuals are depicted, including children and a caretaker holding a baby. Children are seen playing and a caretaker is holding a baby, with two women near a bench or in the cart. Everyone is dressed in colorful garments reminiscent of 18th-century attire. The background features a painted scene with swirling patterns in shades of blue, gray, and earth tones, creating a dreamy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman with text about Yvette Guilbert. The image depicts a detailed sketch of a woman in profile, wearing a checked coat and hat, and holding an object that appears to be an umbrella. To the left of the figure, there is a large block of French text, which includes the name "Yvette Guilbert" prominently displayed at the top. The drawing is part of a printed page, suggesting it might be from a book or an illustrated publication. The use of minimal shading and lines gives the illustration a simplistic appearance.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person depicted from the waist up. They are posed in profile, with their face turned upwards and to the left. The individual appears to have short, light-colored hair, styled simply and neatly. They are dressed in an outfit that features a sleeveless top with dark gloves extending above the elbows. The top part of their attire seems elaborate, possibly with a light-colored shawl or scarf draped around the shoulders. The surroundings include faintly visible text, suggesting the image is part of a printed page with a passage of writing primarily on the right side, alongside the drawing.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is looking upwards with their head tilted back and mouth open. The facial features are not distinctly detailed. The person's hair is dark and short, and they are wearing a garment with puffed sleeves. No jewelry or objects are visible in their hands. The background blends with the text on the page, which is in French and formatted in paragraphs.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person wearing a sleeveless dress and long dark gloves. The person's head is tilted back, facing upwards, with their hair styled in an elegant updo. French text is visible in the background along with other illustrations at the edges of the paper.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a page with text and a pencil sketch. The image features a portion of a text with typed paragraphs in French. On the right side of the page, there is a subtle pencil sketch depicting a human-like figure. The sketch is minimalist and appears unfinished, showing basic outlines and shading.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a woman from the waist up in a standing position, with her hair styled up. She is turned slightly to her right and may be pointing with her right hand. The woman's face is in profile, with a pointed nose and a soft chin. She is dressed in a dress with a puffed sleeve on her left shoulder, suggesting an elegant fashion. In the background are faint sketches of furniture and two men, one sitting and one wearing a top hat. French text fills the surrounding page.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person beside a block of text. The sketch features a figure on the right side of the page, while the left side is filled with text in French. The sketch shows a person in a slightly turned position, with their head tilted back and a hand raised. The style is loose and expressive, with gentle curves capturing movement. The text may be related to the drawing or part of a larger narrative.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a page from a book or a magazine featuring a sketch and text. The drawing combines a lightly sketched illustration on the left side with textual content on the right. The illustration depicts two figures sitting closely. The sketch is minimalist, with delicate lines capturing the expressions and postures of the figures, one seated with a hand to the chin, and the other leaning in with an attentive expression. The rest of the page contains a block of text in French.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing on an open book containing text. The image shows a page with printed text on the left and a sketchy pencil drawing on the right side. The drawing depicts the upper torso of a figure with loosely sketched features. The text is in French and discusses urban settings and societal observations. The combination of literature and art suggests a juxtaposition between verbal and visual storytelling.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman with an updo hairstyle and crossed arms. She is wearing a long-sleeved white dress. The background features French text printed on a cream-colored page.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a a drawing of a figure in a long robe next to written text on a page. The drawing shows a figure with an elongated neck and a faintly detailed face, standing to the left of the page. The background features abstract hatching lines. On the right side, there is a column of neatly printed text, possibly in French, in a formal serif typeface. The drawing and text are on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a page from a book. The left side features text, while the right side has a light sketch. The sketch shows a partial profile bust of a person with simple features including a nose and lips. The person's hair is styled back, and the clothing is only loosely suggested. The background is plain off-white paper with worn edges. No objects or jewelry are included.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing beside a window. French text is included in the composition.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in conversation next to a page of French text. The drawing is done in a soft, sketchy style using light, flowing lines. One figure is holding a hat in one hand and gesturing with the other. The other figure appears to have an elegant posture, adorned with what seems to be a bonnet or hat. The text begins with a continuation of someone else's speech, discussing topics on sentiments and social observations. The drawing and the typography suggest a harmonious blend of visual art with literary content.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Gift of Edwin L. Cox - Ed Cox Foundation
artworks.description: The illustration depicts the upper half of a woman's body turned slightly to her side. She has distinct facial features with subtle eyes and nose, and her head is slightly tilted. Her hair seems styled, and she wears a dress with a deep neckline and long gloves. Her hands are positioned near her neckline. The dress has decorative elements, and the background shows textured shading. Beside the illustration, there is text in French, visually separate from the image.

artworks.title: Iceberg Canyon, Colorado River, Looking Above
artworks.creditLine: Diana and Mallory Walker Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged terrain with a rocky riverbank. A person is sitting on dark rocks near the water, facing the landscape's reflection. In the distance, rocky mountains rise gradually into the horizon. The mountains have sharp peaks and textured surfaces from natural erosion. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a warm and vintage feel. The sky is mostly clear, emphasizing the rocky formations. The composition leads the viewer's gaze along the river towards the distant mountains.

artworks.title: Ludwigstrasse
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash on cream paper, laid on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows buildings in an impressionistic style. A taller building, possibly a church, is visible near the center right. The horizon is depicted with lines. The artwork uses loose brushstrokes to suggest architectural forms. The color palette is primarily grayscale. The sky is left untouched, emphasizing the landscape.
